newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait approves new investment firm.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait approves new investment firm.

text.p: Kuwait's Central Bank has approved the creation of an investment firm with a 30 million dinar ($100 million) capital, a newspaper said on Sunday.
"The Central Bank has approved the licensing of a new investment and finance firm with a 30 million dinar capital," al-Watan daily quoted a well-informed source as saying.
The firm would be allowed to run portfolios and trade in securities, said the newspaper. Founders include European and Gulf firms, it added without giving any details.
